target_customer: E-commerce brands, many on Shopify, that run customer support through helpdesks such as Zendesk and Gorgias
problem: E-commerce support teams drown in repetitive tickets. Minimal AI builds AI agents that resolve tickets end to end across email, chat, WhatsApp and social and take actions in Shopify and similar systems.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI support agents
product_category: AI customer support agents for e-commerce

founders.name: Niek Hogenboom
education: Delft University of Technology, aerospace engineering
previous_startups: Custom suit business started at 16 and sold after three years
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. Also led a solar racing team for a year.

founders.name: Titus Ex
founders.background_notes: Data scientist and ML engineer; has worked on AI since 2018 per the YC page.

competitors.name: Gorgias AI Agent
competitors.what: Shopify focused helpdesk with an AI agent for order status and returns, introduced 2024

competitors.name: Sierra
competitors.what: Enterprise AI agents for consumer brands

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-agent support system built with LangGraph and integrations into helpdesks and Shopify, reliable action taking is harder than answering questions.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and trained process knowledge create some lock-in, but many funded AI support vendors sell the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Helpdesks and AI native vendors all shipped agents; no acquisition of Minimal AI reported by 2026.

market_need_then: E-commerce brands handle large volumes of repetitive tickets; the company claims 80% lower cost per ticket and up to 90% automation (company claims, not independently verified).

branding.domain_note: Uses gominimal.ai, not an exact .com; other companies named Minimal confuse search results.

identity.visual_style: Integration logos, testimonials and case study cards
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, punchy headlines such as resolving tickets end to end

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with other companies, shown by search results that mix in unrelated Minimal entities; no brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Minimal AI went through YC Summer 2025 and raised a reported $3.6M seed in March 2026, with named customers and a LangChain case study showing early production use. It faces both helpdesk incumbents and well funded AI vendors, so the main risk is competition. No exit or shutdown found; the outcome is still open.
notes: Seed amount differs by source: $3.6M from a Dutch outlet and Nordic9 versus $4M from StartupIntros; $3.6M used. Investor list comes from the Nordic9 listing seen in search results.
